scenario_config._comment: All values SI units: metres, seconds, metres/second, metres/second^2. car_start_position_m and obstacle_position_m must match the static translations baked into worlds/obstacle_braking.wbt (the car's and obstacle Solid's X translation) since the world file is not procedurally generated from this config.

initialization_policy: Unavailable readings are counted separately only within a 1 s startup hold, with zero cruise, full brake and <0.05 m ground-truth X displacement. Later invalid readings fail validation.
